method.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; sort_keys=true; separators=(',', ':'); ensure_ascii=true; allow_nan=false
method.unknown_identifier_treatment: An unresolved identifier encoding has no claimed attainable minimum. Nonempty canonical JSON string length >=3 is only a universal conservative inequality, never a truthful one-character witness or alias.
method.lower_bound_logic: If a relaxed projection using universal inequalities already exceeds a cap, every truthful encoding exceeds it. A relaxed projection below the cap proves no feasible witness.
method.generation_profiles: The semantic controller/workspace contracts type generations as id without a frozen width; reviewed candidate A requires 64 lowercase hex workspace/controller generation tokens. Candidate-specific requirements must not be silently promoted to all possible transports.

field_categories.schema_minimum: nonempty str; <=256 UTF-8 bytes; NUL forbidden
field_categories.semantic_requirement: Must identify the exact authenticated original process-local owner relation; equal scalar strings never recreate authority.
field_categories.unresolved: Neither exact textual representation nor width is frozen. HMAC-SHA256 authentication of an enclosing owner record does not imply its IDs are themselves 64-hex.

field_categories.semantic_requirement: Actual full immutable original container identity, never a name or shortened container ID.
Exact original workspace/controller incarnation and generation bound to authenticated observed kernel, container and owner relations; new generation cannot inherit readiness.
Fresh owner-bound IDs; request/operation/admission ID reuse is rejected throughout the retained generation. Cross-message corresponding IDs must match.
field_categories.unresolved: Owner generation and uniqueness are frozen; token byte width and text format are not.

field_categories.semantic_requirement: Strict owner-monotonic positive integer; no reset or wrap. Mutation post-observation uses a separate prebound single-use owner challenge/sequence. At most nine small events can still each have a one-decimal-digit conservative width.

Fresh unpredictable 32-byte single-use owner challenge bound to operation, generations and original relation. Request/response challenge nonnull exactly for the three OBSERVE tags. Mutation request/response challenge=null; nested workspace_state observation_challenge remains 64 hex and separately bound.
Full actual SHA256 of the respective immutable identity, source, class, compiler or captured bytes. Invented hashes are never evidence.
Actual observed mount/root/incarnation and complete seven-namespace/cgroup relation; original owner authentication must bind the full observation. Labels alone do not prove incarnation.
field_categories.unresolved: No fixed serialization of device/inode/starttime/boot/cgroup tuples is frozen. Linux readlink forms, decimal inode forms, 64-hex digests and short aliases must not be invented as mandatory encoding.

field_categories.semantic_requirement: Exact authenticated PID/task/start/group/descriptor/deadline relation. PID alone cannot identify a process incarnation; all relevant original relation bindings remain required.

Real host issuing PID and observed namespace process/task IDs. Reviewed candidate A controller is PID1 with parent_pid=0 and its required main task tid=1. Compiler must be a distinct actual child, fully reaped before successful response snapshot.

minimum_workspace_structure.compiler_exclusion_basis: controller:727 postprocess fully reaps compiler before successful result; workspace:lifecycle.predicates.prepared-artifacts-present requires no running compiler/target JVM.
minimum_workspace_structure.root_metadata_note: Exact observed mode/uid/gid/link_count must be emitted. mode=17407 is S_IFDIR | 01777; whether mode includes full st_mode or permission bits only is not explicitly specified by semantic schema, so treating its five-digit width as universal requires the stat-mode convention. Three-digit lower relaxations are safe only as inequalities.
minimum_workspace_structure.writer_requirement: Every potential/open writer and every handle must be fully inventoried and accounted by the exact original owner relation. No unexpected writer is allowed. Controller can potentially write both 01777 roots; representative conservative profile may include one controller writer with potential_write_access handles to /tmp and /work. The exact descriptor/potential-access representation and minimum record multiplicity are not separately fixed, so writer-free profile is only a strict relaxation and never a truthful feasible witness.

manifests.order: exact absolute paths sorted by UTF-8 bytes
manifests.class_relaxation_note: Using decimal 1 for byte arithmetic is conservative for the length of every valid positive-size class, but is not a truthful Java classfile witness. The frozen exact javac and source determine actual output only if independently derived; no compilation measurement is authorized.
manifests.mode_note: Every manifest entry includes observed integer mode. Typical full st_mode lower type bits are 16384 for directory and 32768 for regular file; exact permission bits need an authenticated observation or a frozen creation rule. Do not confuse those illustrative integers with observed actual modes.

successful_capture_and_reap.child_pid: actual distinct compiler child positive integer
successful_capture_and_reap.process_group_identity: exact actual original group relation; encoding unresolved
successful_capture_and_reap.deadline_identity: exact shared original deadline relation; encoding unresolved

compiler_identity.namespaces: all seven exact fields required; actual identity encoding unresolved
compiler_identity.cgroup_identity: actual authenticated original relation; encoding unresolved

mandatory_result_shape.receipt_issuance_alone_forces_specific_o: Not uniquely stated. OBSERVE_PREPARED_ARTIFACTS explicitly requires an existing preparation receipt. A new complete prepared-state OBSERVE_* is mandatory before readiness/handoff; the frozen text does not uniquely require that exact tag, and it cannot silently be placed before issuance of its own required receipt.

limits: Old IDs/hashes/challenges are illustrative values and cannot authenticate truthful kernel or owner relations.
Writer-free records are a strict structural relaxation only.
Old repeated request/operation IDs and observation sequences are not a valid complete lifecycle.
Old empty capture hashes are all-zero sizing placeholders; exact empty SHA256 has the same serialized width.
Old class size=1 is only conservative relaxation, not valid javac output.
Old result_observation defaults cleanup_barrier_sequence=0 but old capture objects must still enforce exact semantic success values.
Candidate A generation widths are not automatically frozen for unselected architectures.
These response counts omit required request frames, empty readiness and other current observations, cleanup and handoff.
A three-response inequality above8192 is conditional on that observation being included in the cumulative preparation interval; it cannot settle an unresolved attempt endpoint.
